meta_desc: Free construction and DIY calculators: roof pitch, concrete slab, paint, tile and stairs. Instant results, no ads, no tracking, works offline.
og_desc: Roof pitch, concrete, paint, tile and stair calculators. Free, instant, no ads.
lede: Five fast calculators for real jobs. No ads, no tracking, no sign-up. Every result shows the math behind it, and everything keeps working offline once loaded.
card_roof: Rise and run to degrees, percent and X:12, plus the pitch multiplier for roof area.
card_concrete: Volume and the exact number of bags, with a waste margin.
card_paint: How much paint for your room, minus doors and windows, per number of coats.
card_tile: Tiles and boxes from area and tile size, with grout gap and cutting waste.
card_stair: Risers and treads from total height, checked against code limits and the comfort rule.
why_text: Most calculator sites bury a simple formula under ads, popups and newsletter walls. These five tools do the opposite: the calculator is at the top, the formula is printed under the result, and the page loads in a fraction of a second. If a tool saves you a wasted trip to the store, there is a donation button after your result. That is the whole business model.
